title: New Every Morning
question: What does Scripture say is renewed each day, and what stays the same?
blurb: Written in the ruins of a city. Sit with the verses that keep company with it.

nodes.content: What does Scripture say is renewed each day, and what stays the same?

nodes.verseText: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail. They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
“Because I, the LORD, do not change, you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed.
Therefore we do not lose heart. Though our outer self is wasting away, yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.
